text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainie, check out the latest 
gadget info~! ...Wait, not here again 
today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I knew business trips would increase, 
but... I didn't expect it to be this much.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I've been sending relaxing videos she can 
watch in her spare time, but...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Her replies are few and short, she must 
be really exhausted.)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, speak of the devil, Trainy.
choice_data_list:
'Thanks so much for all the relaxing 
tips!'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"The scenic onsen footage in particular 
gave me total chills!" ...huh.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Hot springs, huh. ......

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: All right, let's gather some intel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst busy days, feeling grateful yet 
apologetic for Transcend reaching out... 
one evening, we ended up having a video 
call.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trai-chan! It feels like it's been 
forever since we talked outside of 
training~!
choice_data_list: Yeah. What happened with those clothes?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, whaddya think? Suits me, right? 
It's all part of the hospitality, baby♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm gonna use my handpicked onsen 
goods to immerse you in hot spring bliss 
right down to the bone. Get ready~♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: First up, the bucket speaker!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
See, this is a waterproof hi-res speaker. 
When you float it in the tub, the LED on 
the bottom glows, and it plays ambient hot 
spring sounds!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hear that? The sound of the hot 
spring bubbling up, the birds chirping... 
So soothing, right?♪
choice_data_list: Hmm, it might be a bit hard to hear...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha, gotcha. Oh, maybe if we turn up 
the volume, there's a chance? ...Nah, the 
audio peaking would be terrible.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, just showing that stuff like this 
exists too! The next thing I'm introducing 
is hot spring bath salts~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I even ordered bath salts from famous hot 
spring resorts! The moment they arrived, I 
tried them out in the dorm's bathhouse... 
Oh, I got permission first, of course!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The scent is super unique, ya know. The 
base is sulfur, but with a smoky, earthy 
aroma kicking in—
choice_data_list:
I can't even imagine. I wonder what it's 
like?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You really can't tell without actually 
smelling it. Words alone just can't do it 
justice.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... That thrilling scent, I want to 
tell Trainy about it right now!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and I also tried the onsen water face 
pack from the same place.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And then... my skin got impossibly bouncy 
and soft! Well? Can you tell?
choice_data_list:
Squishy squishy... How's the vibe... 
kinda...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: *slumps* No good, huh...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that, Trainy. The limits of 
being behind a screen were a much tougher 
opponent than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... yeah. Sorry 'bout that, couldn't 
heal it all the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, there were many things that just 
couldn't be conveyed through a screen, and 
the conversation didn't flow quite as 
smoothly as usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I appreciate the thought. Just as 
I was about to say that— Transcend spoke 
first.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how about we call it a day for now? 
And then... we'll get our revenge next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That didn't go so well, huh. I feel like I 
ended up making them worry instead...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What's so different from usual, I 
wonder...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
We finally got the "Ignition Chocolate"! 
Trainy, let's take it at the same time... 
Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh, so spicy!! My mouth is burning...! 
Wait, your face is completely red, Trainy! 
Your eyes are all teary, too! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(What I want to share with Trai-chan... is 
being right by their side, seeing the same 
things, feeling the same sensations—)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Realism", huh.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "...Alright. Just wait for me, Trainy."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'll heal ya with the ultimate, thrilling 
"real deal"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, while I was wrapping up some 
work in the academy's trainer room for the 
first time in a while..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Let's go on a trip, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Our destination is... a hot spring! 
'Course, that's after work settles down.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The plan is to head to a secluded hot 
spring in the mountains together, get a 
little spooked, and then unwind and relax!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: How do you feel about it, Trainer-chan...?
choice_data_list:
Looks like we'll finally get to talk a lot 
after so long.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's my Trainy for ya! Always quick to 
catch on!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's go blow off all that pent-up 
exhaustion and have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Leave the destination to me! You just wrap 
up all that work, Trainy-poo!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'll give your brain a total 
refresh with the ultimate 'thrill'♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There's a ton of stuff I wanna talk 
to you about too, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'll get comfy cushions and tasty snacks 
ready, so let's have a real good chat~!
choice_data_list: Yeah. I'm looking forward to it!
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Let's share this thrill to our hearts' 
content. Side by side, in our very own 
'reality'!"
